All the read/reference behaviour works. Refresh **http://maker:4001**.

**Flow 5 — separating "to read" from "reference."** 

1. Look at the list: each bookmark now carries a small **badge** — either **To read** or **Reference**.
2. Above the search box there's a row **All · To read · Reference.** Click **To read** — the list narrows to only your reading list; click **Reference** for only the keep-for-reference ones; **All** brings everything back. (Search works *within* whichever view you're in.)
3. **Save a new link** — in the review panel there's now a **Type** choice, "To read" or "Reference," so you classify it as you save.
4. On any entry, **Edit** now also lets you **switch its type** — so something you've finished reading can become reference, and nothing is ever lost; it just moves between views.

Decisions to confirm, please react to each:

- **Two fixed groups only** — "To read" and "Reference" — as a built-in split, separate from tags (which can be many and freeform). Is a single either/or split the right model, or do you picture more than two states (e.g. an "archived/done" as well)?
- **New saves default to "To read."** Reasonable default, or would you rather it default to "Reference," or make you choose each time with no default?
- **The switcher is a segmented bar** (All / To read / Reference). If you're unsure about this control, I can show you a couple of alternative layouts to compare — just say so.
